name: @nexus/agent
description: For an agent that holds its own key: a library that reads and writes the encrypted Nexus vault by note path, and the nexus-agent command: an agent runs it to join with one command, and a person runs it to set the vault up and approve an agent by hand. The library is built to one file, with its WebAssembly as a file beside it, that runs in Node and in a Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cli.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
